name: Shiori
message: "This place... didn't leave much of an impression on me back when I was alive."

name: Shiori
message: "But now, it's a really scary place..."

name: Shiori
message: "I really should've tried harder to stop you from spiriting yourself away... If the deity hadn't helped, I don't know what would've happened..."

name: Shiori
message: "...I was honestly panicking back then. You suddenly vanished, and I was the only one left behind..."

name: Shiori
message: "I couldn't follow you into the mirror world, no matter how much I tried... I was flailing around like a headless chicken back there. I think I was about to cry."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm really glad you came back... Please don't ever try any more isekai-type urban legends, okay? Something irreversible might happen someday."

name: Shiori
message: "You really do seem like the type to do that, since you kinda just go with the flow."

name: Shiori
message: "Be careful next time, okay?"

name: Shiori
message: "But it's strange, isn't it? A world reversed, like a mirror... I wonder what that place really is."

name: Shiori
message: "Since you ran into a deity there, does that make it sacred? Maybe I didn't need to panic so much after all?"

name: Shiori
message: "With where this conversation's going, I don't want you getting any weird ideas like wanting to try it again, so I'm going to change the subject."

name: Shiori
message: "I was actually just killing time with small talk, hoping Uribayashi-san would show up."

name: Shiori
message: "You know, I still feel a little guilty. When I heard about the abduction case, I started thinking maybe Uribayashi-san was Girl A..."

name: Shiori
message: "I was so anxious about being Girl A myself... it just made everything worse. Maybe deep down, I was hoping it would be her instead of me..."

name: Shiori
message: "She can't hear me, but I still want to apologize for doubting her."

name: Shiori
message: "But it's really just for my own self-satisfaction, to clear my conscience."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, right. There was something I wanted to tell you too, properly this time."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm sorry about yesterday, for trying to handle everything on my own. I should've relied on you more."

name: Shiori
message: "And thank you. For trying so hard for my sake. I was really happy."

name: Shiori
message: "And not just about yesterday, I mean everything since we first met."

name: Shiori
message: "You stayed by my side this entire time, for a shady ghost like me. Thank you. I really mean it."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, I guess this is for my own self-satisfaction too. I just wanted to thank you properly."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, no point lingering here forever. Shall we go?"
